items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We made a record over the top – the song over the top of the trio.

ctx.x: . . . Eric Alexander. We made a record over the top – the song over the top of the trio. Now we do it sometimes with Javon. We do it with other people. We just had a gig in the Iridium with Eddie Gomez – what’s his – I can’t think of the – when I get to call these names, they start to skip out of my head.
